subject: Discovery recap + reschedule: Acme AI demo
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmeai.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps / demo scheduling

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through Acme AI's use case. Quick recap from my side: 

- Goal: multi-tenant LLM inference with predictable latency for customer-facing features (search augmentation + summarization).
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data, prefer VPC/private deployment, strict audit logs.
- Success metrics: P95 latency < 300ms for short responses; cost target <$0.004/token at scale.

Next step: technical deep-dive + demo with infra/security folks to validate integration surface and compliance requirements. Proposed slots (PT):

- Tue Mar 16 — 10:00–11:00am PT
- Wed Mar 17 — 1:00–2:00pm PT
- Fri Mar 19 — 11:00–12:00pm PT

Can you confirm which of these works (reply with yes/no and preferred attendees)? If none, send a couple times that suit the team and I’ll lock it in. I’m attaching a short product one-pager for context.

Attachment: redwood-overview.pdf (1 page)

If it helps, here’s a booking link: https://calendly.com/marissa-demo/30min — but I can send a direct calendar invite once you confirm.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0148

If you’d prefer tighter confirmation, two options:

1) Confirm now and I’ll send the calendar invite with required attendees + dial-in.
2) Reply within 20 minutes and I’ll keep the slot tentative; otherwise I’ll release it and offer next-best times (Tue 10am PT or Fri 11am PT).

Please let me know which you prefer and who will definitely attend from your side — we’ll tailor the demo to focus on the VPC/private deployment and audit log surface.

I’ve re-attached the one-pager and a short checklist of items we typically cover in the technical deep-dive:
- network topology + egress controls
- key management (KMS/HSM)
- model versioning + rollback policies
- load pattern and expected RPS

Attachment: redwood-overview.pdf

If Wed works, I’ll invite: Marissa (me), Dylan (SE), Jordan (you), Priya (Infra), Mateo (Security) — and we’ll aim for a 60-minute session with a follow-up task list.

Best,
